title: Group Fitness Class Passes: logging a no-show and charging the no-show fee
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states the entry point for handling a member who booked a class and failed to attend it without cancelling, and how the resulting no-show fee is logged against the pack.

## Applicable situation
When a member fails to attend a class session they had booked against a class-credit pack, and did not cancel that booking, the miss is logged against the pack's booking history along with the no-show fee charged for it. Logging the no-show does not change the pack's credit balance, since the credit was already spent when the class was booked; the log only records the miss itself and the fee amount.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): log_class_no_show_ce445694.

## Parameters
- class_pass_id: the reference number of the class-credit pack the missed booking was made against.
- class_session_id: the reference number of the specific scheduled class session that was missed.
- class_type: the studio class type of the missed session — one of yoga, cycling, hiit, pilates, strength, or dance.
- club_id: the reference number of the club location where the missed class was held.
- no_show_fee_usd: the no-show fee amount to charge, in USD, rounded to exactly two decimal places, always zero or a positive amount.

## Return
On success, log_class_no_show_ce445694 returns a confirmation naming the new booking-history entry, echoing the class_pass_id it was logged against, stating that credits_delta is 0 (no change to the credit balance), and stating the amount_usd charged. No error, review, or correction behavior beyond this confirmation is defined for this tool.
